description.ro: Referința comenzilor ase-moodle, generată din parserul real: cont, cursuri, teme, forumuri, note, quizuri, notificări, API Moodle și instalare.
description.en: The ase-moodle command reference, generated from the real parser: account, courses, assignments, forums, grades, quizzes, notifications, Moodle API and install.

text.ro: Toate comenzile scriu JSON pe stdout, iar erorile merg pe stderr ca `{"error": "...", "message": "..."}`. Tabelul de mai jos este generat din parserul real: numele, opțiunile și ajutorul vin din cod. Aici găsești comenzi CLI ase-moodle pentru același cont Moodle ca uneltele MCP.
text.en: Every command writes JSON on stdout, and errors go to stderr as `{"error": "...", "message": "..."}`. The table below is generated from the real parser: the names, options and help come from the code. All ase-moodle CLI commands cover the same Moodle account as the MCP tools.

paragraphs.ro: `N` înseamnă un număr întreg, `JSON` un obiect JSON, iar `A|B` o alegere dintre valori. Opțiunile fără valoare sunt comutatoare. Comenzile care modifică contul cer `--yes`.
paragraphs.en: `N` means an integer, `JSON` a JSON object, and `A|B` a choice between values. Options without a value are switches. Commands that change the account need `--yes`.

paragraphs.ro: Textul pentru `submit-text`, `reply` și `new-discussion` vine din `--text`, dintr-un `--file` sau din stdin, prin pipe.
paragraphs.en: The text for `submit-text`, `reply` and `new-discussion` comes from `--text`, from a `--file` or from stdin, through a pipe.

paragraphs.ro: Coloana „Ce face” din pagina românească afișează textele de ajutor ale comenzilor, exact cum le dă `--help`. Pagina engleză le traduce, iar numele și opțiunile rămân aceleași.
paragraphs.en: The Romanian page's “What it does” column shows the commands' help texts, exactly as `--help` gives them. The English page translates them, while the names and options stay the same.

rows.ro: eroare: Moodle, token lipsă, fișier inexistent, ciorne dezactivate
rows.en: error: Moodle, missing token, missing file, drafts disabled

paragraphs.ro: Comenzile `claude`, `codex`, `opencode` și `antigravity` merg doar la adaptorul lor. Fiecare acceptă `install`, `update`, `uninstall` și `doctor`, cu `--scope global|project` unde există. Antigravity nu are scop de proiect: `--scope project` este o eroare.
paragraphs.en: The `claude`, `codex`, `opencode` and `antigravity` commands go only to their own adapter. Each accepts `install`, `update`, `uninstall` and `doctor`, with `--scope global|project` where it exists. Antigravity has no project scope: `--scope project` is an error.

paragraphs.ro: `ase-moodle install` fără nume de harness rulează toate adaptoarele. Un harness care nu suportă scopul cerut este sărit, cu motivul în output.
paragraphs.en: `ase-moodle install` without a harness name runs every adapter. A harness that does not support the requested scope is skipped, with the reason in the output.

text.ro: Fără `--yes`, o scriere se oprește cu codul `2` și nu trimite nimic. Adaugă `--yes` doar după ce ai verificat exact ce trimite comanda.
text.en: Without `--yes`, a write stops with exit code `2` and sends nothing. Add `--yes` only after you have checked exactly what the command sends.

en.login: Get the token and save it. `auto` uses the browser when Playwright is available, otherwise the clipboard.
en.logout: Delete the saved token. `--forget-browser` also deletes the Google session in the browser profile.
en.auth-status: Check the saved token with a real call; returns `logged_in` and the user name.
en.whoami: Show the connected account, the site and the number of Web Service functions available.
en.courses: List enrolled courses, filtered by study year, semester, academic year, type or name.
en.outline: Raw course structure: sections, modules and files.
en.download: Download course materials in parallel; existing files of the same size are skipped.
en.assignments: List assignments, optionally limited to some courses.
en.assignment: Submission state for one assignment: drafts, submitted files or text, grade and feedback.
en.submit: Upload a file as the assignment submission; a draft by default, final with `--submit`.
en.submit-text: Send online text as the assignment submission; the same options as `submit`.
en.forums: List forums, optionally limited to some courses.
en.discussion: Posts of one discussion, with text and attachments.
en.reply: Reply to a forum post; requires `--subject` and `--yes`.
en.new-discussion: Start a new forum discussion; requires `--subject` and `--yes`.
en.grades: Grades for every course, or the grade items of one course with `--course`.
en.quizzes: List quizzes, optionally limited to some courses.
en.quiz-attempts: Your past attempts at a quiz.
en.quiz-start: Start an attempt; each attempt counts against Moodle's limit.
en.quiz-questions: Questions of an attempt, with the answer field names and options.
en.quiz-answer: Save answers, or finish the attempt with `--finish` (irreversible).
en.quiz-review: Review a finished attempt: questions, answers and marks (raw Moodle data).
en.notifications: Recent notifications and the unread count; `--unread` for unread only.
en.read-notification: Mark a notification as read; requires `--yes`.
en.deadlines: Upcoming deadlines in the next N days, sorted by time.
en.functions: Web Service functions available to the token, with an optional regex filter.
en.call: Call any Web Service function with JSON parameters; non-read functions need `--yes`.
en.install: Configure the plugin in the chosen clients, globally or for the current folder.
en.uninstall: Remove the configuration from the chosen clients.
en.update: Bring the latest marketplace version; restart Claude Code afterwards.
en.doctor: Check the installation, the token, the MCP processes and the Moodle functions.
en.sync-plugin: Development: copy the canonical SKILL.md into the plugin.
en.claude: Install, update, uninstall or check the Claude Code harness only.
en.codex: Install, update, uninstall or check the Codex harness only.
en.opencode: Install, update, uninstall or check the opencode harness only.
en.antigravity: Install, update, uninstall or check the Antigravity harness only (global).

claims.text: Toate comenzile scriu JSON pe stdout, iar erorile merg pe stderr.
Textul pentru submit-text, reply și new-discussion vine din --text, --file sau stdin.
Comenzile claude, codex, opencode și antigravity merg doar la adaptorul lor.
Antigravity nu are scop de proiect; --scope project este o eroare.
install fără nume de harness rulează toate adaptoarele, iar unul nesuportat este sărit cu motivul în output.
37 de comenzi, generate din parserul real.
